generator: dot candidate generator; unverified model identity
objective: For nonzero odd integer n and P=(x,y) on y²=x³−n²x over Q with v₂(x)<0, v₂(x(2^kP))=v₂(x)−2k for all k≥0; hence P has infinite order. Specializing to n=5, P=(25/4,75/8) gives rank≥1, not rank=1 or an analytic rank claim.
